Entry.JapaneseText: しっかり者に見えるけれど、やっぱりまだ子ども。 そのうっかりさが、子どもらしい愛らしさ
Entry.EnglishText: She seems dependable, but at the end of the day she's still just a kid. Her absent-mindedness is just part of her charm as a child.

Entry.JapaneseText: 孤独とて、情けが欲しいわけではない。それが忍び。 時々、家族が恋しい。我と来て遊べや親のない雀
Entry.EnglishText: I may be lonely, but I do not need your pity. And yet sometimes, I long for family. Come and play with me, you sparrows without parents.

Entry.JapaneseText: そっと舞い降り、そっと行動する、それが忍び。 目立ってはいけない。寒鴉己が影の上におりたちぬ
Entry.EnglishText: To silently descend, to silently take action - that is the way of the ninja. One must not draw attention. The raven perches upon its own shoulder.

Entry.JapaneseText: 明日の運命、生きるか死ぬか、見えない、それが忍び。 不安でも泣かない。夕燕我にはあすのあてはなき
Entry.EnglishText: Whether tomorrow leads to life or death, I know not - that is the way of the ninja. Though anxious, I weep not. Like the swallows, I have no plans for tomorrow.

Entry.JapaneseText: レベル４０、烈風のように這い、舞い飛び、斬る、 それが忍び。はやぶさの地にさす影か風のきく
Entry.EnglishText: At level 40, she's like a fierce gale, soaring and slashing. That is the way of the ninja. Like a falcon, her only trace is her shadow and the sound of the wind.

Entry.JapaneseText: レベル６０、常に厳しい現実を見据える、それが忍び。 逃避すべからず。夢よりも現の鷹ぞたのもしき
Entry.EnglishText: At level 60, she faces the grim reality head on - that is the way of the ninja. She flees not. The hawk that is present is more truthworthy than any dream.

Entry.JapaneseText: レベル８０、いつもそばにひそんでいる、それが忍び。 姿は見えず気配もせず。何処やらに鶴の声聞く霞かな
Entry.EnglishText: At level 80, she's always lurking nearby - that is the way of the ninja. Her form is never seen, and no presence can be felt. Only the echo of a crane can be heard through the haze.

Entry.JapaneseText: 教え込まれた忍びの掟。スキなく、揺るぎなく非情。 でも仲間と呼べる人たちとの邂逅で少しだけ変わった
Entry.EnglishText: The way of the ninja is to be flawless, steadfast, and ruthless. But meeting those I could call comrade changed me just a bit.

Entry.JapaneseText: 若干１２歳にして、忍者の里の精鋭たちを率いるボス。 幼いながらにその器量は、天を包むほどに大きい
Entry.EnglishText: At the tender age of 12, she commands the elite ninja of her village. Though young, her talent is as vast as the heavens themselves.

Entry.JapaneseText: 少々のことで照れない動揺しない、忍びですもの。 将来、ある意味で大物の予感
Entry.EnglishText: Such trivialities won't faze her, she's a ninja afterall. Besides, she's set to be a big shot in the future.

Entry.Notes: Event: Defeat the three Clay Demons in Mjolnir Cave

Entry.JapaneseText: 貴方を初めて見た時、体に電気が流れた気がしました。 恋でしょうか？ いえ……あれは違いましたね
Entry.EnglishText: When I first laid eyes on you, it felt like a current of electricity ran through my body. Is this what love is?
